summary.text: George Nardone is a Republican state representative who has represented District 28 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 1, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Nardone was assigned to the House Finance Committee, the Municipal Government Committee and the State Government and Elections Committee.
